newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco launches $21 mln private domestic airline.
newsitem.headline: Morocco launches $21 mln private domestic airline.

text.p: Morocco on Monday launched a domestic private airline named Regional Air Lines with an initial investment of 200 million dirhams ($21 million), the official MAP news agency reported
"The new firm, which aims to contribute to the development of domestic air links, will start operating from July 14," MAP said.
It gave no details of the number of aircraft to be operated by Regional Air Lines.
The inauguration ceremony was presided over by Crown Prince Sidi Mohammed and attended by government officials in Morocco's financial centre of Casablanca, MAP added.
Up to now, the state-run Royal Air Maroc airline has been the only company to operate domestic flights, including flights in the disputed Western Sahara territory.
